verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official, keylessly installable CLI (ykman) with fully scriptable device management, so the device can be driven headlessly from scripts. However, FIDO2 cryptographic operations require a physical touch for user presence, and CI use needs a physically attached key; touch can reportedly be disabled only for some modes. Missing for 10: documented CI or headless-runner guidance, an evidenced way to perform crypto operations without physical presence, and hands-on CI corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Configure your YubiKey via the command line.
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
FIDO2 also requires user presence (a touch on your YubiKey) for cryptographic operations
you can just turn it off for most modes.
